column4: SimHash64.fingerprint sets a bit on votes > 0 (a tie votes 0) while M3IndexDbChunkSimHash.simHash64 sets it on votes >= 0 (a tie votes 1), both return 0 for the empty window: over 20,000 seeded unit-weight windows of 0..64 features the two agree on every untied or empty window and differ exactly on the tie mask elsewhere (0 unexplained); M3HammingTopK consumes long[] fingerprints and is independent of the rule, so the distance reuse is exact while the fingerprint overlap is a documented difference, not an equivalence (NEC)
